description: The bar chart titled "NDCG@10" illustrates the performance of different methods in a conversational recommendation system, as measured by the normalized discounted cumulative gain at 10 items. The vertical axis represents the NDCG@10 values, ranging from 0.05 to 0.25, with a linear scale. The horizontal axis lists four methods: "Ours," "critiquing," "scoring," and "ranking." The "Ours" method, represented by an orange bar, has the highest value, approximately 0.20. The "critiquing" method, shown in blue, has a value around 0.15. The "scoring" method has the lowest value, close to 0.05, and the "ranking" method has a value slightly above 0.10. The chart does not indicate any specific sorting or visual emphasis on the bars.
